civil-marriage.title: Support for a civil marriage option, by group
civil-marriage.question: "In general, do you support also having an option for civil marriage in Israel? (Civil marriage is marriage by the state rather than by religious authorities such as the Chief Rabbinate)"
civil-marriage.note: Support is "strongly support" plus "somewhat support" in JPPI's table. Opposed: 60% of traditional-religious, 77% of religious and 85% of Haredi respondents. The last row is JPPI's "Arabs" (the source does not say whether Druze are included): 46% opposed and 15% did not know. All Israelis: 55% support.

civil-marriage-intermarriage.title: Support for civil marriage when the question includes marriages between Jews and non-Jews
civil-marriage-intermarriage.question: "What is your view on civil marriage if it would also include the possibility of marriages between Jews and non-Jews?"
civil-marriage-intermarriage.note: A separate follow-up question in the same survey as the chart above, so the two charts are not one series. Support is "strongly support" plus "somewhat support" in JPPI's table. Opposed: 59% of traditional-not-religious, 87% of religious and 94% of Haredi respondents. The last row is JPPI's "Arabs": 48% opposed. All Israelis: 44% support, 50% opposed.

shabbat-transit.title: Support for public transport on Shabbat outside religious areas, Jewish respondents, by group
shabbat-transit.question: "Do you support or oppose operating public transportation on Saturdays (Shabbat) throughout the country, except in areas with major ultra-orthodox or religious populations?"
shabbat-transit.source: Reichman University, Institute for Liberty and Responsibility
shabbat-transit.note: "Don't know" answers excluded. Left and right are respondents' own placement on a 1–7 scale. The report's text gives no April 2022 figure for the right; its lowest reading was 47.3% in September 2022. For all Jewish respondents (67.1% to 73.8%) and secular respondents (87.6% to 92.5%) it gives only the range across its surveys, not figures by date. The report gives no sample sizes.
